comment: HS 293329 = 'Heterocyclic compounds containing an imidazole ring (whether or not hydrogenated), not condensed' — a bulk API/intermediate heading. FDC's declared trade is overwhelmingly finished medicaments in dosage form, which fall in 3004 (and ORS/electrolyte drinks in 2106/3004 depending on presentation), not in 2933. So the declared code is a wrong classification for the actual product mix: partial overlap only if FDC exports imidazole-ring bulk actives (e.g. an imidazole antifungal intermediate) — that specific line is not evidenced here. Recommended correction: primary 30049099 (other medicaments, retail) with 30049011 (ayurvedic/ herbal, if such lines), 21069099 (electrolyte/ORS food-type preparations) and 30021500/30042019 for any immunological/antibiotic dosage lines; keep 293329 only for a documented bulk imidazole API line. Industry field 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification — FDC is pharmaceuticals/healthcare (pharma FDF + nutraceuticals), not petrochemicals. No trader signs: own manufacturing plants (Rohika/Baddi, Waluj, Sinnar, Goa) and own brands, so role = manufacturer. Per project rule 3 this HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company stays in the base with corrected codes and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No customs line was available to me in this session, therefore no shipment-level corroboration of any HS code — all codes above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
